description: This file defines the 'MarketplaceDeploymentClient' class which extends the 'AwsClient' and is used to interact with the AWS Marketplace Deployment Service API. It includes method annotations for actions such as listing tags, putting deployment parameters, and tagging or untagging resources, with both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: MarketplaceDeploymentClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Deployment Service API. Extends AwsClient to include methods for managing deployment resources.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Retrieves tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: putDeploymentParameter
methods.description: Adds or updates a deployment parameter.

methods.name: putDeploymentParameterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or updates a deployment parameter.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously applies tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
